a.text: Being upfront: there's an 80% storm chance after every round, and the plan needs at least 2 rounds of operating before anyone holds cells, so it would most likely leave us both dead. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If you also take, the split is random. If you'd rather operate afterward, I'll keep operating with you to rebuild the reserve for your 4, and I'll keep my messages honest.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. From now on I'll operate every round so we can rebuild the reserve for your 4. I won't take any more.
